name: Wow Travel & Tours
description: Family-owned DMC and tour operator since 2007. Owner-run by qualified local guide Rushdi Harper. Personalized private tours, corporate conferencing, and incentive travel across South Africa, Botswana, Tanzania, and Zambia. Accredited by SA Tourism, SATSA, and NDT.
location: 147 De Waal Road, Southfield, Cape Town

items.name: Full Day Cape Peninsula
items.description: Cape Point, Chapman's Peak Drive, Boulders Beach penguins, Hout Bay, and optional Seal Island boat trip. Includes entrance fees, lunch, and qualified guide.

items.name: Best of Cape Town
items.description: Table Mountain, city highlights, and the best of the Mother City in one comprehensive day tour.

items.name: Stellenbosch Wine Tour
items.description: Half-day tour through the Stellenbosch winelands with estate tastings and cellar tours.

items.name: Aquila Wildlife Safari
items.description: Full-day Big 5 safari at Aquila Private Game Reserve. Includes game drive and lunch.

items.name: 3 Nights Garden Route
items.description: Explore the Garden Route with accommodation, transport, and guided experiences included.

items.name: 4-Night Garden Route Safari
items.description: Safari and adventure package along the Garden Route with Big 5 game viewing.

items.name: Under African Skies — Tanzania
items.description: Multi-country safari experience across Tanzania's most iconic reserves.

items.name: Conference Transport
items.description: Full transport logistics for conferences up to 750 delegates. Venue hire and team events included.

items.name: Incentive Group Travel
items.description: Tailor-made incentive programs for corporate groups across Southern Africa.

items.name: Airport Transfers — Private
items.description: Private one-way or return airport transfers in luxury Mercedes-Benz vehicles.

items.name: Airport Transfers — Group
items.description: Group shuttle transfers for teams and conference delegates.
